field.name: name
field.definition: Human-readable file name or logical object name.

field.name: type
field.definition: Declared file/object type; implementations validate it against the actual object.

field.name: id
field.definition: Stable implementation-defined identifier for the file or copy set.

field.name: definition
field.definition: Optional concise description of the file's intended function.

field.name: author
field.definition: Declared author or provenance label; not an inferred identity.

field.name: os_spawn
field.definition: Operating-system installation or process context that created the file record.

field.name: education_id
field.definition: Optional reference to educational documentation or provenance; not a measure of a person.

field.name: probable_scout_level
field.definition: Optional declared project score for alignment with documented conduct and educational objectives. Authorized declaration only; otherwise unknown.

field.name: hold_type
field.definition: Extensible generic hold classification with no executable authority.

field.name: overall_health
field.definition: unknown, healthy, warning, degraded, or failed.

field.name: content_identity
field.definition: Content digest or equivalent identity for physical-copy comparison.

field.name: sense_ordinal
field.definition: Physical copy/Sense number constrained to 1, 2, or 3.

field.name: source_device_id
field.definition: Opaque identifier for the device supplying health evidence.

field.name: health_evidence_source
field.definition: smart, nvme, scsi, filesystem-check, or unknown.

ubuntuWhiteGenericTypes.privacy: Person-related fields are optional provenance declarations and must never be automatically inferred from file content, filenames, ratings, or device data.
